title: George Osborne’s speech at the British Museum Annual Trustees’ Dinner 2023
author: George Osborne

notes.text: Official speech by the Chair of the British Museum, selected for A Short History of Taking Things and Keeping Them. Printed page 4 acknowledges failure in the duty of care following thefts from the stores; page 7 discusses a proposed Parthenon partnership without relinquishing claims or changing the law. These are statements made in November 2023, not a current account of recovery or negotiations. Read the acknowledgement alongside the proposed remedies, rather than treating the speech as a claim that care is unnecessary. No individual object is identified for linking. Title, speaker, date and relevant passages were verified from indexed official PDF text. Direct web retrieval did not yield the PDF; no licence for a publicly redistributed copy was established. No capture is registered.
